svg.title: Pop operation in a stack, six-stage sequence
svg.desc: Diagram showing six stages of stack pop operations, starting from a full stack of 10, 20, 30, 50 and removing the Topmost element one at a time until the stack is empty, followed by a final pop operation resulting in a Stack Underflow error.
svg.text: Highlighted box = element about to be popped · Top pointer index always points to it
